title: Brush Rodeo Association youth dance
author: madwire
excerpt: July 3rd, 2011 JAMMIN’ DJ’s made the dance kickin on the night before the 4th of July. The whole rodeo crowd got involved and loved every minute. Big thanks to the Brush Rodeo Association and congradulations to the Brush Rodeo Queen ~Jason Radke

July 3rd, 2011

JAMMIN’ DJ’s made the dance kickin on the night before the 4th of July. The whole rodeo crowd got involved and loved every minute. Big thanks to the Brush Rodeo Association and congradulations to the Brush Rodeo Queen

~Jason Radke
